text:
Jonah: low-key idea 9 sunset sandwich swap + frisbee on the park lawn after work this Friday? bring a sandwich/snack to trade, optional blanket. :sandwich: :sunset: :flying_disc:
Priya: love it. what time are we aiming for?
Jonah: meet at 6pm in the lobby, walk over. leaves time for a quick change.
Hana: i'm in. i'll bring my infamous tofu banh mi (veg folks beware, it's addictive).
Felix: i'll bring chips and a thermos of iced tea.
Rae: can someone bring a bluetooth speaker? small one is fine.
Jonah: @Rae noted. i'll grab the speaker. also thinking a 10-min micro game: 'emoji charades' for prizes (tiny stickers).
ops-bot: FYI: Weather forecast shows clear evening, 65F. Park permits not required for small gatherings.
Priya: yay. any dietary tags for swaps? i'll label mine gluten-free.
Hana: i'll label spice level too.
Felix: quick poll: bring blanket? yes/no
Jonah: (tally) yes wins. we'll have a couple blankets but bring if you can.
Rae: i'll bring an extra blanket and a small picnic light.
Jonah: perfect. i'll post a calendar invite and a quick map. see you Friday  casual clothes, picnic vibes. :star2:
